subject: Best stunt car
author: Dodger455
body:
The Hawker is one of the all around best cars for stunts, it handles well, e-brake is good, and it drifts well, the speed is not bad.The GT feels heavy, and you just can't get the kind of spins you need out of it in a stunt run.

The Carbon X-12 is rowdy if you can keep it straight, but it has speed, and is a blast to drive!
